name: chair
advice: Budget: about 24 triangles (78 today, 3.3 times the budget): boxes or one plane with an alpha-cut or painted texture; painted by the facade shader past ~240 m.
Legs as open boxes or 3-sided prisms (8 or 6 triangles) with the fake rounded-corner shader, not cylinders of 8 sides with caps.
Remove its 4 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
4 round part(s) (cylinders, prisms): thin ones as boxes without caps or 3-sided prisms and the fake rounded-corner shader; caps that touch another part left out.
36 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
